about.deps.title: Third-party libraries
about.deps.subtitle: This app is built with these open-source libraries — thanks to their authors. Each is used under its own license.
about.dep.dotnet: The app framework and UI (Windows Presentation Foundation) the whole application runs on.
about.dep.naudio: Audio capture & DSP — powers the desktop audio waveform widget (WASAPI loopback + FFT).
about.dep.avalonedit: The code editor with line numbers and syntax highlighting used in the service-config editor.
about.dep.lhm: Hardware sensors (CPU/GPU power, temperature, load) for the system overview / temperature monitor.
about.dep.speech: System text-to-speech, used for the hardware temperature voice alerts.
